evidence.scope: Supplier product SV025 only; not a universal wafer tolerance or NXE:3800E input specification
evidence.note: SV025 product tolerance. Other products differ: SV026 lists ±10 µm. Thickness is not rendered in the planar comparison. A tolerance bound is not a statistical confidence interval.
